tables.sourceSql: CREATE TABLE "authors" (au_id CHAR(11) CHECK (au_id GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]') NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, au_lname VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, au_fname VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, phone CHAR(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT ('UNKNOWN'), address VARCHAR(40) NULL, city VARCHAR(20) NULL, state CHAR(2) NULL, zip CHAR(5) NULL CHECK (zip GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'), contract INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "discounts" (discounttype VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, stor_id CHAR(4) NULL REFERENCES stores(stor_id), lowqty INTEGER NULL, highqty INTEGER NULL, discount DECIMAL(4,2) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "employee" (emp_id CHAR(10) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK ( emp_id GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z][1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][FM]' OR emp_id GLOB '[A-Z]-[A-Z][1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][FM]'), fname VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, minit CHAR(1) NULL, lname VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 REFERENCES jobs(job_id), job_lvl INTEGER DEFAULT 10, pub_id CHAR(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT ('9952') REFERENCES publishers(pub_id), hire_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('2000-01-01'))

CREATE TABLE "jobs" (job_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, job_desc VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'New Position - title not formalized yet', min_lvl INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (min_lvl >= 10), max_lvl INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_lvl <= 250))
CREATE TABLE "pub_info" (pub_id CHAR(4) NOT NULL REFERENCES publishers(pub_id) PRIMARY KEY, logo BLOB NULL, pr_info TEXT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "publishers" (pub_id CHAR(4) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (pub_id IN ('1389', '0736', '0877', '1622', '1756') OR pub_id GLOB '99[0-9][0-9]'), pub_name VARCHAR(40) NULL, city VARCHAR(20) NULL, state CHAR(2) NULL, country VARCHAR(30) NULL DEFAULT('USA'))
CREATE TABLE "roysched" (title_id CHAR(6) REFERENCES titles(title_id), lorange INT NULL, hirange INT NULL, royalty INT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "sales" (stor_id CHAR(4) NOT NULL REFERENCES stores(stor_id), ord_num VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, ord_date TEXT NOT NULL, qty INTEGER NOT NULL, payterms VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, title_id CHAR(6) NOT NULL REFERENCES titles(title_id), PRIMARY KEY (stor_id, ord_num, title_id))
CREATE TABLE "stores" (stor_id CHAR(4) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, stor_name VARCHAR(40) NULL, stor_address VARCHAR(40) NULL, city VARCHAR(20) NULL, state CHAR(2) NULL, zip CHAR(5) NULL)

CREATE TABLE "titleauthor" (au_id CHAR(11) NOT NULL REFERENCES authors(au_id), title_id CHAR(6) NOT NULL REFERENCES titles(title_id), au_ord INTEGER NULL, royaltyper INT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (au_id, title_id))

CREATE TABLE "titles" (title_id CHAR(6) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, type CHAR(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT ('UNDECIDED'), pub_id CHAR(4) NULL REFERENCES publishers(pub_id), price NUMERIC NULL, advance NUMERIC NULL, royalty INT NULL, ytd_sales INT NULL, notes VARCHAR(200) NULL, pubdate TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('2000-01-01'))

views.name: titleview
views.sourceSql: CREATE VIEW titleview AS select title, au_ord, au_lname, price, ytd_sales, pub_id from authors, titles, titleauthor where authors.au_id = titleauthor.au_id AND titles.title_id = titleauthor.title_id
